rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun in accusative singular masculine referring to the hidden true nature
absolutive of jñā, expressing having known
compound gūḍha plus sadbhāva in accusative singular masculine
abstract noun sarvajñatva in nominative singular neuter as subject
middle voice present third singular of pra-jan

items.question: What arises when one knows the hidden true nature?
premises: knowing hidden true nature causes all-knowingness
items.inference: Knowledge of the hidden true nature produces all-knowingness.
uncertainties: exact referent of taṃ depends on prior context
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
